title: Doctests from 462 are not enforced: crate is bin-only, cargo test never compiles them
description: 462 (landed 2026-09-23) added 16 doctests to src/models.rs, src/operations.rs, src/storage.rs written against pebbles::<module>:: paths. The crate is bin-only (Cargo.toml has no [lib]), so `cargo test --doc` reports 'no library targets found' and the doctests can rot unseen. Fix options: (a) add a [lib] target with src/lib.rs exposing the modules so doctests run in CI, or (b) convert doctests to plain docstring examples. (a) is the better long-term answer and matches the traditional Rust setup; it changes crate structure, so it needs owner sign-off. Verified 2026-09-23: all 16 doctests pass under a temporary [lib] scaffold.
